decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the latest reference as the foundation, preservation of its core message, and replacement of weak material with stronger unique wording.
Using and improving the latest reference script does not change the independently established source or testimonial-style presentation of testimonial material.
The source changes reference-based messaging instructions but does not alter the target audience age range or market scope.
The source contains no instruction changing or removing the required integrated call to action.
Stronger, unique, non-generic reference-aligned wording is compatible with the existing viral-style requirement and does not modify or replace it.
Using a reference script as a creative foundation does not transfer script-production responsibility to the client or change the sourcing obligations for script, visuals, or voiceover.
The source gives general script-revision instructions but does not specifically change the established requirement for a direct, Indian-market-appropriate opening hook.
The source does not alter the lead-generation objective or the target cost per lead; the later conversion-priority message cannot be used for this source-time audit.
The reference-script revision does not change video counts, duration, formats, pilot sequencing, or follow-on order conditions.
The source concerns script messaging and does not change lip-sync accuracy or facial-expression requirements.
The source does not resolve or modify the existing production-method conflict concerning live-action footage and AI-generated scenes.
The source changes script development instructions but does not alter actor nationality or gender preferences.
